blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
IT helps every Czarnikow office, from London to São Paulo. When you talk to the help desk or join an online meeting, you need a little English.

Yesterday there was a problem. The system was down for one hour. Two computers were slow, and the team was busy all morning. At the end of the day, everybody was tired.

Today the system is working well. Small IT habits protect the whole company. If something looks strange, call IT support. You can do it!

items.q: What happened yesterday?
options: There was a problem with the system
items.why: "Yesterday there was a problem. The system was down for one hour."

items.q: How long was the system down?
items.why: "The system was down for one hour."

items.q: How was the team at the end of the day?
items.why: "At the end of the day, everybody was tired."

items.q: The text suggests that today the situation is…
items.why: Inferência: ontem havia um problema; hoje "the system is working well" — melhor que ontem.

items.q: What would the writer most likely say?
options: Small IT habits help the company
items.why: Inferência: "Small IT habits protect the whole company" — o autor valoriza os bons hábitos de TI.

blocks.instruction: Ouça James falar sobre o problema de TI de ontem. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi, thanks for coming. Let's look at yesterday's IT problem together. It's quick, don't worry.

Yesterday morning, the system was down. It was down for about one hour. Your computer was slow, and the internet was not stable. I know you were busy, and at the end of the day you were tired. I'm sorry about that.

The problem was on the shared drive. It was a small thing, but two computers were slow because of it. The help desk was very busy yesterday, so the answer was a little late.

Today everything is fine. The system is up, your computer is fast again, and the shared drive is back. Please tell me if it is slow again. Was the meeting okay in the end? Good. Small habits help a lot. Save your work often, and call us early. You did well. Thank you!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is James talking about?
items.why: "Let's look at yesterday's IT problem together."

items.q: Where was the problem?
items.why: "The problem was on the shared drive."

items.q: How was the person yesterday, according to James?
items.why: "I know you were busy, and at the end of the day you were tired."

items.q: Why was the answer a little late?
options: The help desk was very busy
items.why: "The help desk was very busy yesterday, so the answer was a little late."

items.q: What can you infer about James?
options: He wants to close the help desk
He is angry with the user
He is kind and wants to help
He does not care about the problem
items.why: Inferência: ele pede desculpas, elogia ("You did well") e dá dicas — é gentil e prestativo.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The email was slow yesterday, but it is fast today." Yesterday means…
items.why: Yesterday = ontem, o dia antes de hoje.

items.q: "The website is down, so I can't log in." Down here means…
items.why: Down = fora do ar, não está funcionando.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "I was ___ after a long day of meetings and calls."
items.why: Tired = cansado, o resultado de um dia longo.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Sorry, I can't talk now. I'm very ___ with the report."
items.why: Busy = ocupado, sem tempo agora.

items.q: "There is a small problem on the shared drive." A problem is…
items.why: Problem = problema, algo que está errado e precisa de solução.

blocks.instruction: Expressões e phrasal verbs simples que aparecem em TI e reuniões. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Please log in with your name and password." To log in means to…
options: enter a system with your account
items.why: Log in = entrar num sistema com sua conta (nome e senha).

items.q: "I always back up my files before I go home." To back up means to…
options: save a copy of the files
items.why: Back up = fazer uma cópia de segurança dos arquivos.

items.q: "Please shut down your computer at the end of the day." To shut down means to…
items.why: Shut down = desligar o computador.

items.q: "The system was down, but now it is back up." To be back up means to be…
items.why: Back up (aqui) = de volta ao ar, funcionando de novo.

items.q: "I will look into the problem this morning." To look into means to…
items.why: Look into = investigar, checar com atenção.
